limitations: Browser event and canvas timing, not physical input-to-photon or scanout.
20 keyboard presses per seat; input p95 did not consistently improve.
Control restores equivalent getError after replica teardown rather than the original in-draw call.
Native input X-motion detection is exploratory and can be affected by collision/momentum.
Profiler discovery failed one simulation gate; excluded from acceptance.
Earlier discovery screenshots ran during the measurement and contaminated maxima; clean comparisons moved screenshots after completion.
Pre-fix release refresh failures lost sessionStorage on cached isolated HTML; no gameplay metrics accepted from those runs.
